social_security_taxable.regular_case: Let S=net benefits, P=worksheet provisional income (half S+other income+tax-exempt interest+required addbacks-minus specified adjustments). B=32000 joint,25000 single/HOH/surviving/apart-MFS. W=12000 joint,9000 others. taxable=min(.85*S,min(.5*S,.5*min(max(P-B,0),W))+.85*max(P-B-W,0)).
social_security_taxable.limits: Lump-sum election, repayments, IRA deduction interactions and nonresident rules require separate handling. Provisional income is not necessarily displayed AGI.
